Name: Patrobas
Summary: Patrobas was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, and Hermes.
KeyStory: Patrobas was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, and Hermes.
LifeLesson: The church is built of named individuals, not anonymous crowds.
